## Drawing review

- Show on drawing highlights the selected location with a high-contrast circle.
  Question locations include a scrollable note describing the item, the question
  and why it needs review.
- Unrecognized tags now include drawing locations, allowing each occurrence to
  be viewed. Rescan older jobs to collect these locations. Identified tags retain
  their locations when added to the BOM.

## AI providers

- Added xAI Grok, Groq, Mistral AI, OpenRouter and Together AI to the provider
  selector. Each requires an API key and a vision-capable model ID supporting
  the OpenAI chat-completions image format. These integrations have not been
  tested against live provider APIs.
- AI review sends drawing and scope data to the selected provider. Review all
  results against the source drawings.

Standard Windows and macOS downloads do not bundle Tesseract OCR.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.21...v0.1.22
